name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom kitchen cabinets?
mainEntity.text: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom and semi-custom cabinets solve different problems. Custom cabinetry is made to fit the exact dimensions of the kitchen, which makes it ideal for irregular layouts, older homes, tall ceilings, and highly specific storage needs. It also allows more flexibility in door style, interior organization, paneling, and fit around appliances. Semi-custom cabinets are based on standard cabinet boxes but offer more choices than stock cabinets, such as limited size adjustments, finish options, and storage upgrades. Semi-custom is often faster and more budget-friendly, while custom cabinetry delivers the most precise fit and the strongest design consistency. Homeowners should compare not only the front-end price but also the long-term value of space utilization, durability, and aesthetic quality. In Los Angeles homes where kitchen space may be tight or architecture is highly individualized, custom cabinets often make sense when the goal is to maximize storage and create a built-in look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are built to exact dimensions and design choices, while semi-custom cabinets use standard cabinet boxes with more finish, size, and storage options. Custom cabinetry is better for unusual layouts, ceiling-height builds, and unique storage needs.
